# Cognax website: design brief (read fully before building)

Cognax is a workspace where people upload documents/spreadsheets, ask an assistant (Naxie) questions and get answers that
point to their source, and build dashboards, presentations and automations from the same data. We are building its
**multi-page public marketing site** (static HTML generated by `build.js`).

## Why this redesign exists
The previous version was rejected: it "looks like an AI website" (dark theme, purple/pink aurora glows, gradient headline
text, glass cards, pill badges, identical bento cards, flat mock screenshots). The client wants **clean, modern, animated,
with real 3D imagery**.

## Direction: clean, bright, confident, product-first
- Light canvas (white / `--bg-soft`), generous whitespace, hairline borders, big calm type (Geist), ONE accent (indigo `--brand`),
  logo orange `--accent` only as a tiny highlight. At most ONE dark band per page (the closing CTA, already styled).
- The **3D object is the hero**. Real Three.js scenes (not CSS gradients pretending to be 3D): soft studio lighting, clay/matte
  and glossy materials, soft contact shadows, slight depth of field feel via composition. Think Apple/Linear/Stripe product
  imagery, not sci-fi.
- Motion is purposeful and smooth (GSAP + ScrollTrigger, `power3/expo` eases): one orchestrated hero intro, 3D objects that
  react to pointer (subtle parallax) and **scroll-driven 3D choreography** (objects rotate, separate, assemble as you scroll).
  Not every element fades up; do not animate for its own sake.

## Hard "don'ts" (these are the AI-site tells)
No gradient text. No blurred glow blobs / aurora. No glassmorphism cards. No dark-by-default theme. No "New" / announcement
pills above the headline. No row of 3 identical icon+title+blurb cards. No ALL-CAPS tracked eyebrow labels. No 01/02/03 numbering
unless the content really is a sequence. No emoji. No fake stats, customer logos, testimonials, pricing or security claims. No
Lorem ipsum. No `→` appended to every button. Don't center everything: use asymmetric, editorial layouts.

## Content rules
Only describe what the product demonstrably does (see `reference/old-build.js` for vetted copy per page, and the facts below). Mock
UI/data shown in visuals is illustrative, never real customer data. Copy: plain, specific, user-perspective, sentence case, active voice.

Product facts: **Naxie** = assistant chat: ask about uploaded documents, extracted data, dashboards; find a clause, summarize
risk/obligations, explain data (totals/trends/comparisons), resume past conversations. **Knowledge Base** = files, folders,
metadata; upload, create folder, star, filter by status/domain/tags. **Dashboards** = report groups; source-backed reports
created inside each dashboard; shared reports. **Presentations** = decks generated from connected data. **Connections** =
reusable sources (Excel today) for dashboards, presentations and automation; type/status/tags. **Data & Automation** = Data
Tables (structured records), Prompt Studio (templates that shape document extraction), Automation Docks (pipelines that run,
deploy, monitor workflows). Tagline: "Upload anything. Ask anything. Trust the answer."

## Architecture (follow exactly)
```
website/
  styles.css          SHARED design system. DO NOT EDIT. (tokens, nav, buttons, .hero-grid, .stage3d, .row, .ui, .tbl, .tag, .cta-band, footer)
  main.js             SHARED. DO NOT EDIT.
  src/layout.js       SHARED. DO NOT EDIT. (page shell, ctx helpers)
  three/stage.js      SHARED. DO NOT EDIT. createStage(), THREE, mat.*, slab(), palette, reduced
  src/pages/<n>.js    YOURS: module.exports = (ctx) => ({ file, title, desc, body })   ctx = { LOGIN, svg, PRODUCTS, cta, APP }
  css/<n>.css         YOURS (auto-included if it exists, after styles.css; prefix every class with your page, e.g. .nx-*)
  js/<n>.js           YOURS (auto-included as <script type="module">; gsap/ScrollTrigger globals exist; registerPlugin is done)
  three/<n>.js        YOURS: scene builders imported by js/<n>.js
  reference/          old files, copy source only
```
Read `three/stage.js` header comment for the API. Mount a scene: put `<div class="stage3d" data-stage="x"><span class="fallback">...</span></div>`
in the page HTML and call `createStage(el, build)` in js/<n>.js. Drive scroll choreography by tweening `stage.state.progress` (or
object transforms) with ScrollTrigger (`scrub`). Build shared geometry/materials once; keep scenes < ~60k triangles, no external
model/texture files (everything procedural: ExtrudeGeometry, RoundedBox-like `slab()`, lathe, tubes, instanced meshes, canvas
textures for text/UI faces are fine). Text/UI faces on 3D objects: draw to a `<canvas>` -> `THREE.CanvasTexture` (set
`colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace`, anisotropy 8) so cards look like real product UI.

Each page = hero (copy left, 3D right, or a different composition if it fits) + 2-3 feature sections that each have their own
visual (3D scene, scroll-driven 3D, or a tilted product-UI card) + a light "works with" text-link row (no card grid) + `ctx.cta(...)`.
Pages must feel individually designed, not the same template with swapped text. Reuse the Cognax brand: indigo + white + tiny orange, logo mark
is a rounded triangle (see `assets/logo.svg`, `assets/group.png`).

## Quality bar (verify before you report done)
- `node build.js` succeeds. Page loads at http://localhost:8080/<page>.html (static server already running on :8080 serving this folder).
- Zero console errors / failed requests (ignore favicon 404). No horizontal scroll at 1440, 1024, 390 widths.
- 3D visible and good-looking at desktop and mobile (390px); on mobile keep it smaller/simpler. `prefers-reduced-motion`: render a
  finished static pose, no looping/scrubbed motion. WebGL failure: page still readable (fallback span).
- Contrast AA, keyboard focus visible, headings in order, meaningful `aria-label`s, canvas is `aria-hidden` (already done by stage).
- Screenshot yourself and critique honestly: if it looks like a template or an "AI site", redo it. Check the hero at 1440x900 first
  frame AND after intro; scroll-driven states mid-scroll; mobile.

```js
const b = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.LOCALAPPDATA + '\\ms-playwright\\chromium-1243\\chrome-win64\\chrome.exe',
  args: ['--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist'] });
```
Software WebGL is slow: wait 3-4s after load before shots, and scroll in steps (e.g. 300px with short waits) so ScrollTriggers fire
before full-page screenshots. Use viewport screenshots at specific scroll positions for scroll-driven scenes.

## Boundaries
Touch ONLY your own files. Do not run anything that rewrites others' files except `node build.js` (it regenerates all pages from src; that is fine).
If shared files need a change (e.g. a missing helper), do not edit them: work around it in your own files and mention it in your report.
Do not commit, deploy, or publish anything. Do not log into or contact external services.
